items.title: Miami Beach Baila! by Commissioner Joe Magazine at the Bandshell
items.location: Miami Beach Bandshell, 7275 Collins Avenue, Miami Beach
items.description: MIAMI BEACH ¡BAILA! by Commissioner Joe Magazine at THE BANDSHELL FREE, monthly, social dancing for our residents of all ages! Salsa | Bachata | Merengue Join Commissioner Joe Magazine for another exciting edition of his monthly Salsa, Bachata & Merengue Social – this time at the iconic Miami Beach Bandshell. Bring the whole family for an unforgettable evening of latin dancing, vibrant music and community spirit. New to dancing? Come early for a free lesson, learn some new moves and make some friends along the way! Click here to RSVP Date: Sunday, November 22 Lesson: 7 PM – 7:30 PM Party: 7:30 PM – 10 PM Location: The Miami Beach Bandshell 7275 Collins Avenue Dress Code: Smart Casual Parking: $1.25/h 299 72nd St Important: rain or shine, covered openair space. For more info: 786.697.9182 Stay Updated! Join our VIP Event Announcements: SAVE this number +1 786 697 9182 as “MB Baila!” Message “JOIN” on Whatsapp

items.title: Julia Tuttle Causeway Shoreline Cleanup
items.description: King tides have left a wave of trash along the shoreline. Join us to help protect our bay. RSVP required at cleanmiamibeach.org. Wear closed-toe shoes and bring a reusable water bottle. Volunteers under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Community service hours are available. Check RSVP information for the precise meeting point.
items.flyerAlt: Post king tide cleanup flyer: December 19, Julia Tuttle Causeway westbound, 8–10 AM. RSVP at cleanmiamibeach.org. Closed-toe shoes required; bring a reusable water bottle. Ages under 16 must attend with a guardian. Community service hours provided.
